literature_proposed.summary: This node is the finitely-many form of Ecklund's conjecture (equivalently Selfridge's, with the single exception C(62,6)) in the range n >= k^2: exceptions have bounded k. No proof is known; the best unconditional result bounds the least prime factor of C(n,k) by a constant times n/k^c for some c > 0, which does not reach n/k.
